cells.gaps: No source found saying whether any transfer goes without the authority's prior authorisation, or of a published list of countries or model terms.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): Guideline CDPG 5 of 2024 bars transfers unless the authority is notified and conditions are met [ZWE-001], but it also sets out a letter requesting prior authorisation [ZWE-002]; openness is not shown either way, so the stage is 2. The 24 authorisations [ZWE-003] are noted, not staged.
